item.title: U.S. warns allies of possible Iranian strike after midterms
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Washington warned allies of a potential Iranian response after Nov. 3 midterms, AP reports; Qatar proposing a seven-day confidence plan. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: CIA assessment: Iran has three response options to new U.S. strikes
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to Washington Post, CIA assesses that Iran could respond with Strait actions, cyber strikes, or attacks on overseas U.S. targets. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: Iran's annual inflation hits 88.7%: rural-urban gap widens
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
